_note: Hand-editable map notes, condensed from the cited wiki pages. Key = map name as the game/aoe2companion shows it; 'aliases' are other names that should match (e.g. custom map file names). Fields: resources (starting resources per player), extra (additional resources), tips (short), sources. The official one-line description comes from data/maps_official.json (tools/update_maps.py). Research pass 2026-11-12.

Arabia.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 2–4 Deer or 6–8 Chickens · 6 Berries · Gold 7/5/5 · Stone 5/4
Arabia.extra: Small 3-tile gold and stone piles scattered sparsely
tips: Open map – expect Feudal Age rushes
Gold/stone in front of your base is the usual rush target
Wood comes in medium patches, sometimes far apart

Arena.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer or 8 Chickens · 6 Berries · Gold 7/5/5 · Stone 5/4
Arena.extra: 1 gold + 1 stone pile just outside your walls, plus neutral piles in the middle
tips: You start behind stone walls – booming is safe, early rushes are slow
Take the gold/stone just outside your walls first
Big open middle – armies clash there later

Black Forest.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 7/4/4 · Stone 5/4
Black Forest.extra: 3-boar packs and small fish ponds spawn out in the forest; extra gold/stone pile on each side
tips: Wall early – agree with teammates who walls which gap
Look for the extra 3-boar packs and fish ponds – contest them
Enemies may sneak a Villager in before your walls close

Rage Forest.resources: Like Black Forest: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer · 6 Berries
Rage Forest.extra: Community Black Forest variant (Rage Forest tournaments) with fairer lake distribution between teams
tips: Wall early – agree with teammates who walls which gap
Look for extra boar packs and fish ponds in the forest
Combat usually ramps up late – boom behind walls

Nomad.resources: Sheep in pairs · single Boars · 3-Deer herds · 6 Berries · fish
Nomad.extra: No Town Center or Scout at start; +275 wood / +100 stone for the TC
tips: Find a spot with food and wood and build your Town Center fast
Explore with one or two Villagers first

Land Nomad.resources: Sheep/Cows · single Boars · 3-Deer herds · no Berries
Land Nomad.extra: No water; 3 scattered Villagers, +275 wood / +100 stone; 5-minute treaty
tips: Build your Town Center fast near food and wood

Hideout.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer (inside or outside walls) · 6 Berries · Gold 5/4 · Stone 4/4
Hideout.extra: 2 small gold piles + 1 stone pile near each player
tips: You only have palisades – add a second layer or Houses vs Feudal rushes
Full booming is risky; fast Castle/Imperial pressure is common
Most wood is in the center between players

Fortress.resources: No herdables · 2 Boars · 6 Berries · Gold 7 · Stone 5
Fortress.extra: You start inside walls with towers
tips: Early rushes don't work – opponents harass resource camps outside walls
Breaking in needs siege or a Castle drop

Gold Rush.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 4/3 · Stone 5/4
Gold Rush.extra: Most gold is in the central desert, guarded by wolves
tips: Fight for the central gold early – whoever holds it wins the economy
Many wolves in the center

Atacama.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 7/4/4 · Stone 5/4
Atacama.extra: Extra small gold/stone pile at a distance from each player; center has forests but few other resources
tips: Plenty of resources outside the center, but only small tree groups
Control the outer gold/stone and deny it to the enemy

Four Lakes.extra: Fish only in the four corner lakes
tips: Open map – rushes work as usual
Contest the corner lakes for fish

Mongolia.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 3–4 Deer herds · 6 Berries · Gold 7/5/5 · Stone 5/4 · large woodlines
tips: Cliffs make walling easy – turtle and boom is viable
Back walls with towers/castles and archers

Highland.extra: Rivers with shallows between players; fish in rivers; extra Sheep pairs in corners
tips: Defend the shallows with towers or a Castle and patrol them
Watch for landings by Transport Ship

Socotra.resources: 6 Sheep · 1 Elephant · 5 Zebras · 6 Berries · Gold 4/4 · Stone 2/2
Socotra.extra: Tiny island, wood only at the map edge
tips: Close quarters – fighting starts immediately

Islands.extra: Every player on their own island
tips: Control the sea; attack with Transport Ships
Resources are limited – wood can run out
The navy decides the game

Baltic.extra: Central sea; teams connected by narrow land strips
tips: Wall the narrow land strips
Control the sea; attack with transports and Galleons
Land rushes work – few natural walls
Fewer land resources – use fish

Continental.extra: Rivers/lakes between teams with shallows; wood in piles; more gold than usual
tips: Watch the shallows and land passes to the center

Mediterranean.extra: Central sea; extra herdables in groups of three around the land ring
tips: Scout for the extra herdables
Control the central sea (fish, transports)

Ghost Lake.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 7/4/4 · Stone 5/4
Ghost Lake.extra: Fewer resources than usual, many wolves
tips: Feudal rush into fast Castle works well
Wolves punish early Militia/Villagers

Oasis.extra: Asymmetric central forest around a lake
tips: Both turtle-and-boom and early rushes work

Acropolis.resources: 8 Sheep · 2 Boars · 3–4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 4/3 · stone only in the valley
Acropolis.extra: You start on a plateau; slopes can't be built on
tips: Hill bonus helps defense, but walling is hard
Few resources on top – you must go down eventually

Budapest.extra: Every player starts with two Town Centers
tips: Very fast economy and Feudal times
Enemy TC can be close – turtling is hard
Scout a lot and adapt to the layout

Amazon Tunnel.resources: 8 Sheep · 3 Boars · 3 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 6/6/6 · Stone 4/4

Enclosed.extra: Berries, gold and stone only outside the enclosure (many small piles in the outer ring)

Lombardia.resources: 8 Cows · 2 Boars · 3–4 Deer · 6 Berries · Gold 7/4/4 · Stone 5/4

African Clearing.resources: Sheep pairs · Elephants · 3-Deer herds · no Berries · fish in ponds
African Clearing.extra: Nomad-type start; sparse trees, dense forest at the map edge
